Subject: Post-call: technical deep dive scheduling (invite not received)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Summary: we covered your latency targets for inference (<=120ms p95), data isolation requirements, and the initial integration points (FHIR ingestion pipeline + model output sink).
- Action: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with our solutions engineer to walk through the runbook and a short demo of the expected throughput profile.

I attempted to send an invite for Tue 31 May at 10:00 AM PT, but I heard from your Ops team that the calendar invite never arrived on their side (looks like an outbound URL rewrite happened).

To keep momentum, propose these stacked windows (all PT):
1) Tue 31 May — 10:00–11:00 (primary)
2) Wed 1 Jun — 08:00–09:00 (backup, earlier slot for APAC attendees)
3) Thu 2 Jun — 14:00–15:00 (fallback)

Please reply with which window works best or suggest two alternatives. If the invite still doesn’t arrive we’ll provide a direct Zoom link + a dial-in phone number and attach an .ics you can import.

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda) and proposed-windows.ics (manual import option).

Thanks — happy to coordinate with your IT to debug the invite delivery if you want us on that call.

—
Marissa Cole
